calls.reasoning: Two writes to Home (an event and a reminder), then read the week back so the summary reflects what is actually on the calendar.

calls.text:
Both are in. Your week:

- **{{weekday+0}}** · Cash-flow standup, 10:00
- **{{weekday+1}}** · Vendor invoice review, 13:30 · reminder at 09:00 to send the variance report
- **{{weekday+2}}** · Dentist, 09:00 · **Budget review, 15:00** (new)
- **{{weekday+4}}** · Month-end close prep, all day

The budget review lands well clear of the dentist, so nothing overlaps.
